title: ECall Redial Indication
description: Backs ICallListener::onECallRedial(phoneId, ECallRedialInfo{willECallRedial, reason}). Mirrors CallManagerServerImpl::onECallRedial(), fired from ecall.session.EcallSession's Redialing state at each attempt: willRedial=true + CALL_ORIG_FAILURE/CALL_DROP on every attempt that fails but more remain; willRedial=false + MAX_REDIAL_ATTEMPTED once the configured attempts are exhausted; willRedial=false + CALL_CONNECTED if an attempt connects (test-hook driven -- see action_ecall.yaml's force_ecall_redial_mode).
